writing-for-agents.note: Adapted: unslop pass over the prose, sharpened rule that a description is a trigger not a summary, SKILL-MECHANICS rewritten for astack's harnesses and sibling-path reach, unslop pointer and encode-lessons pruning rule added.

unslop.note: Rules verbatim; rule numbers are stable ids other skills cite. Description shortened to a human-facing line; disable-model-invocation set, from which the installer generates the Codex policy.

principles.note: Sixteen of the 23 principle skills as plain files under one index skill. Frontmatter dropped, with each description's trigger sentence restored as the first body line. Cross-links rewritten to sibling files, references to pstack-only skills and to the upstream project's own subsystems removed. Edited beyond that: migrate-callers puts its preconditions before the rule, fix-root-causes bounds the pattern sweep to the change's scope and gives the why loop a stop, boundary-discipline bounds trust to the types and defines the shell, encode-lessons states its mechanism ladder once, and the files that lacked a test have one.

open-pr.note: Rewritten as eight steps with done-when criteria. Cursor forge, deslop, and stack machinery removed; no-comments and technical-writing became sibling skills the steps link; global Pull Requests rules are the policy source; Gitleaks hook install and T3 Code PR linking added.

babysit-pr.license: MIT, kept in skills/babysit-pr/LICENSE-pstack and LICENSE-mattpocock
babysit-pr.note: Single PR, three modes, conflicts-threads-CI order, CI classification, triage rubric with the dismissal patterns and their sources. Stack, merge-queue, Origin forge, and the TypeScript watch-pr replaced by scripts/pr.py (stdlib + gh: status, reply, review, resolve). Merge-conflict steps from Matt live in conflicts.md.

review-pr.license: MIT, kept in skills/review-pr/LICENSE-pstack and LICENSE-mattpocock
review-pr.note: Interrogate's shape (intent, parallel read-only reviewers, rubric, lead judgment) with the rubric pointing at ../principles files pasted into the prompt, the code-quality lens folded into the rubric and judgment, the evidence ladder from blast-radius, Matt's spec axis and spec-source order as a separate reviewer, and a worktree for the PR head. Model table and Cursor config removed.

blast-radius.note: Evidence ladder moved to evidence.md so review-pr shares it. References to the why and arena skills replaced with the gh commands they stood for.

technical-writing.note: Verbatim apart from a shorter description, the unslop pointer as a sibling link, and one pstack-specific formatting line removed.

no-comments.note: The Comment Sicko subagent is gone; its keep list and flag rules are the skill body, applied by the agent itself. The /how, /why, and /architect calls became read-the-history and sketch-the-shape instructions; principle references point at ../principles files.
